1445-2921-4871-6277.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-2921-4871-6277.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
On Wings of Gold triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

5254-6495-6627.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature with power 4 or greater.
5254-6495-6627.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the creature with power 4 or greater.
When the creature dies, Warbeast of Gorgoroth triggers, creating a 0/0 Army creature token if you don't control one, then putting four +1/+1 counters on an Army you control.
Resolve the Evereth ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evereth
Repeat.
5254-6495-6627.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

1409-6097-8160.description:
Activate Kwia by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Kwia enters, Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability and Hinterland Sanctifier trigger.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Kwia.
Resolve the Hinterland Sanctifier trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Kwia triggers, creating a Lotus token.
Activate the Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Cavalier of Night

728-4089-5011.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Glasspool Mimic.
When Glasspool Mimic dies, its last ability from Cavalier of Night triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Cavalier of Night.
When Glasspool Mimic enters the battlefield, its first triggered ability from Cavalier of Night triggers; choose not to sacrifice a creature.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability from step 1.
Repeat.

777-1170-5131-6495--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
777-1170-5131-6495--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Foundry Inspector.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the artifact, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evereth
Repeat.
777-1170-5131-6495--202.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

338-4659-5086-5183-7824.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
338-4659-5086-5183-7824.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Triskelavus triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}
Repeat from step 1.

891-2511-5617.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Fungal Fortitude triggers, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it triggers, returning Fungal Fortitude from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability from step 1.
Repeat.

1008-7282-7340.description:
Activate Undermountain Adventurer by tapping it, adding six {G}.
Activate Chrome Dome by paying {5}, creating a token copy of Sewer-veillance Cam.
When the Sewer-veillance Cam token enters, it triggers, untapping Undermountain Adventurer.
Repeat.

582-1409-2557.description:
Activate Brazen Freebooter by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Brazen Freebooter enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Brazen Freebooter.
Resolve the Brazen Freebooter trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

225-539-3573-3634.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four artifacts.
225-539-3573-3634.description:
Activate Tolarian Academy by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}{U}
Cast Venser by paying its mana cost.
When Venser enters as a land due to Ashaya, it and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Venser trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Tolarian Academy.
Repeat.
225-539-3573-3634.notes: Once you have infinite mana, Stone-Seeder Hierophant can either tap for {G} or untap other nontoken creatures and/or lands you control.

2457-4289-4365-7060.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

3490-4050-6458-6824.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to gain life.
Thunder of Unity's second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
3490-4050-6458-6824.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Thunder of Unity triggers, causing you to gain life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Spider-Man triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the Spider-Man trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

5073-5220-6559-6900.description:
Activate Tinder Wall by sacrificing it.
When Tinder Wall dies, Mortuary and Venerated Stormsinger trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Tinder Wall from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Venerated Stormsinger trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Cast Tinder Wall from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

3755-4222-5251.description:
Activate Emmara by tapping it, adding {U}.
Emmara triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Emmara.
Repeat.

2232-2921-3542-6843.easyPrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {W}{W}{W}{W}{W}.
2232-2921-3542-6843.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {W}{W}{W}{W}{W}.
Cast Anti-Venom by paying {W}{W}{W}{W}{W}.
When Anti-Venom enters, its first ability and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning nothing to your hand.
Resolve the Anti-Venom trigger, returning Palinchron from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Palinchron enters, it and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Palinchron trigger, untapping up to seven lands.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Anti-Venom from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Palinchron.
Repeat.

222-527-1753-6797.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-1753-6797.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Phantom Train twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

1339-1808-5256-6625.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing a creature token.
When the creature dies, Eloise's first and second abilities trigger, causing you to create a Clue token and then to surveil 1.
Matoya triggers, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

397-3330-5670.notablePrerequisites:
You control an additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
397-3330-5670.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Stimulus Package by sacrificing the Treasure, creating a 1/1 Citizen creature token.
When the Citizen enters the battlefield, Leyline of Vitality triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

2781-5686-5987.description:
Cast Felidar Guardian by paying {3}{W}.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Angel of Indemnity.
Holding priority, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Felidar Guardian.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian ability, blinking Angel of Indemnity.
When Angel of Indemnity enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Felidar Guardian from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2 any number of times.
Resolve all abilities from step 3, creating any number of Blood tokens.

457-955-5159-5491.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Mishra triggers, creating a token copy of Worldwalker Helm that is a 4/4 Construct artifact creature with haste named Mishra's Warform, and a Map token.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping a Map, adding {U}.
Activate Mishra's Warform by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, creating a token copy of it and a Map token for each Mishra's Warform and/or Worldwalker Helm you control.
Activate Urza's first ability twice by tapping two Maps, adding {U}{U}.
Repeat from step 3.
457-955-5159-5491.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Urza's ability.

2792-4050-5003.notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {3}.
2792-4050-5003.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Great Whale, adding one mana of any color.
When Great Whale dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, returning Great Whale from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attaching Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Great Whale enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Repeat.
If the lands can tap to produce at least {4}, this combo nets infinite mana.

527-979-4824.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 9 or greater.
527-979-4824.description:
Activate Likeness Looter by paying {3}, causing it to become a copy of Selvala.
Activate Likeness Looter using Selvala's ability by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {7}{G}{U}.
Activate Likeness Looter by paying {3}, causing it to become a copy of Soliton.
Activate Likeness Looter using Soliton's ability by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

3443-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Freed from the Real attached to Deathbloom Ritualist.
Deathbloom Ritualist does not have summoning sickness.
You have at least two creature cards in your graveyard.
3443-4222.description:
Activate Deathbloom Ritualist by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Deathbloom Ritualist.
Repeat.

1242-1424-3386.notablePrerequisites:
Born to Drive and Nurturing Presence attached to Cinderhaze Wretch.
Cinderhaze Wretch does not have summoning sickness.
1242-1424-3386.description:
Activate Cinderhaze Wretch by tapping it, creating a 1/1 Elf Warrior creature token.
The Elf Warrior enters the battlefield, triggering Cinderhaze Wretch, giving Cinderhaze Wretch +1/+1 until end of turn.
Activate Cinderhaze Wretch's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat.
